name: Ma cherie ~Bijo to Yajuu to Mitsumeru Hitomi~
original_name: マ シェリ ～美女と野獣と見詰める瞳～
source:
This is a story of a stalker Demon Asmodeus based on the fairy tale "Beauty and the Beast". It's a pure love, but dark story.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个根据童话《美女与野兽》改编的跟踪狂恶魔阿斯摩蒂斯的故事。这是一个纯粹的爱情，但却黑暗的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
